text: Official CLI (create-playcanvas) scaffolds a full Vite/TypeScript project from 12 starters
quote: Use `create-playcanvas` to scaffold a Vite and TypeScript project for the Engine, React, or Web Components from one of 12 runnable starters.

text: Modern ES-Module class-based scripting format recommended for new projects
quote: ESM Scripts (`.mjs` files) — Modern ES Module-based scripts using class syntax. **Recommended for new projects.**

text: Editor supports drag-and-drop visual scene building with real-time multi-user collaboration
quote: Want drag-and-drop scene building, real-time collaboration, or prefer visual tools over code

text: Multiple people can edit the same scene simultaneously without merge conflicts
quote: Multiple developers, artists, and designers can build the same scene simultaneously—no merge conflicts, no stepping on each other's toes.

text: Checkpoints let you snapshot a project state and roll back later
quote: Checkpoints — Snapshot your project at any point and roll back if needed

text: Official MCP server connects AI assistants to a live Editor session and can modify/verify project data
quote: The PlayCanvas Editor MCP Server connects AI assistants to an open PlayCanvas Editor session. It can modify project data and verify the result through the viewport or a running application.

text: Engine can be used standalone, outside the Editor, for building applications
quote: Build applications against the Engine directly. Learn how to use the Engine standalone.

text: Built-in physics components: rigidbody for movement, collision for shape, joints for constraints
quote: The rigidbody component decides how an entity moves, the collision component gives it a physical shape, and the alpha joint component constrains bodies to one another.

text: Editor API module lets developers automate workflows, build custom editing tools, and integrate external systems
quote: This module is essential for developers looking to streamline their workflow, create custom editing tools, or integrate external data and systems into the PlayCanvas Editor environment.

text: Apps can be downloaded for self-hosting outside PlayCanvas's own hosting
quote: Download Apps for Self-hosting

text: React integration lets you build declarative 3D scenes from React components/hooks
quote: `@playcanvas/react` builds PlayCanvas Engine scenes declaratively from React components and hooks, with the full engine underneath.

text: First-class support for loading and rendering 3D Gaussian Splats
quote: Gaussian Splatting - First-class support for loading and rendering 3D Gaussian Splats

text: Engine is installable as an npm package into standard JS toolchains
quote: npm install playcanvas

text: Live editing lets you tweak materials, positions, and scripts while the app is running
quote: Make a change, see it instantly. With live editing, you can tweak materials, adjust positions, and even modify scripts while your application runs.

text: New projects ship with 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving AI coding agents project-specific dev/verification workflows
quote: New projects include PlayCanvas Skills, which give compatible AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific development and verification workflows.

text: Scripts are reusable code attached to entities to define behavior, input handling, and game logic
quote: Scripts are the heart of interactivity in PlayCanvas. They're reusable pieces of code that you attach to Entities to define behaviors, handle user input, manage game logic, and bring your projects to life.

text: Engine automatically falls back from WebGPU to WebGL depending on browser support
quote: The engine will seamlessly fall back from WebGPU to WebGL based on browser support.

text: Physics is powered by ammo.js, a WebAssembly port of the Bullet physics engine, exposed via components
quote: PlayCanvas physics is powered by ammo.js, a WebAssembly port of the open source Bullet physics engine. You work with it through components.

text: Web Components package builds declarative PlayCanvas scenes in plain HTML with no build step
quote: `@playcanvas/web-components` builds PlayCanvas Engine scenes declaratively from custom HTML elements (`<pc-app>`, `<pc-entity>`, `<pc-camera>` and so on), in plain HTML with no build step

text: SuperSplat Editor cleans, crops, colors, animates and exports Gaussian splats in the browser
quote: The SuperSplat Editor cleans up, crops, colors, animates and exports splats in the browser.

text: superspl.at hosts and publishes splat scenes with public pages
quote: superspl.at hosts published splats, each on a public scene page, and lists yours on the Manage page.

text: SplatTransform CLI/library converts, filters, merges, LOD-generates, voxelizes and renders Gaussian splat data
quote: SplatTransform (`@playcanvas/splat-transform`) is a CLI and library for 3D Gaussian splats: it converts between formats, transforms, filters and merges splat data, generates streamed levels of detail, voxelizes splats for collision, and ren

text: PCUI component library (with React wrappers) lets developers build their own browser-based tools like the Editor
quote: PCUI (`@playcanvas/pcui`) is the UI component library the PlayCanvas Editor is built with, for building browser-based tools, with React wrappers.

text: Editor is fully browser-based, requiring no downloads or installation
quote: The PlayCanvas Editor is a powerful, browser-based development environment for creating stunning 3D applications. No downloads, no installations—just open your browser and start building.

text: Provides REST API access to project data
quote: Access to REST API

text: Loading screen can be customized
quote: Customize PlayCanvas Loading Screen

text: Projects can be archived and restored
quote: Project Archive and Restore

text: Editor API supports programmatic scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tool integration
quote: The Editor module provides a comprehensive API for automating and extending the functionality of the PlayCanvas Editor. It allows developers to programmatically interact with the Editor, facilitating tasks such as scene manipulation, asset

text: Same components and properties work identically across Editor, raw Engine, React, and Web Components
quote: The same components, with the same properties, are available whichever way you build: in the Editor, directly against the engine, in PlayCanvas React and in Web Components.

text: SuperSplat provides an end-to-end pipeline: clean in Editor, publish to superspl.at, curate in Studio, embed via open-source Viewer
quote: SuperSplat turns a raw 3D Gaussian splat capture into a shareable scene: clean it in the browser-based SuperSplat Editor, publish it to superspl.at, curate the viewing experience in Studio, and embed it anywhere with the open-source SuperSp

text: Undo/redo functionality is built on Observer's History system
quote: Undo and redo come from Observer's `History`.

text: Scripts can be edited locally via a VS Code extension, or scenes changed via Editor API or an MCP-connected agent
quote: Edit its scripts locally with the VS Code extension; change scenes from code with the Editor API, or from an agent with the MCP server.

text: PlayCanvas is an open-source game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU
quote: PlayCanvas is an open-source game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU. Use it to create interactive 3D apps, games and visualizations that run in any browser on any device.
